zh:
开源无头 CMS，自托管或使用云端，由你掌控。

开源无头 CMS，100% 使用 JavaScript/TypeScript，灵活且可完全自定义。

文档 · Strapi Cloud · 路线图 · Discord · 讨论


Strapi 是一个开源、自托管的无头 CMS，帮助开发者快速构建内容 API，同时为内容创建者提供友好的编辑界面。定义内容模型后，Strapi 会生成完整 API，可供前端、移动应用或物联网设备调用。 - 使用[**内容类型构建器**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/content-type-builder)可视化设计内容结构，无需编写代码 - 为每种内容类型自动生成 [**REST**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/api/rest) 和 [**GraphQL**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/plugins/graphql) API - 开箱即用的细粒度[**角色与权限**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/users-permissions) - 内置[**媒体库**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/media-library)、[**国际化（i18n）**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/internationalization)和[**草稿与发布**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/draft-and-publish) - 全面支持 **TypeScript**，提供灵活的数据库选项（SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB） - 可扩展的[**插件系统**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/plugins-development/developing-plugins)和可自定义的管理界面 > 查看全部功能： **[strapi.io/features](https://strapi.io/features)** > **Strapi AI** —— 使用 Strapi 内置 AI 层自动处理内容建模、媒体替代文本和翻译。[了解更多](https://strapi.io/ai) ### Strapi 如何处理请求 每个传入请求都会经过分层后端架构：**Routes → Middlewares → Controllers → Services**。

> 有关后端自定义的更多信息，请参阅[官方文档](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/backend-customization)。 ## 开始使用 阅读入门教程，或按照以下步骤操作： ### ⏳ 安装 使用以下 **Quickstart** 命令快速创建一个新的 Strapi 项目： ```bash npx create-strapi@latest my-project ``` 此命令会生成一个包含默认功能的新项目（身份验证、权限、内容管理、内容类型构建器和文件上传）。 > 完整安装选项（包括 TypeScript、`--quickstart` 等）请参阅 **[CLI 安装文档](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/installation/cli#creating-a-strapi-project)** ### 系统要求 > 硬件与软件要求（操作系统、Node.js、数据库）请参阅 **[要求文档](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/deployment#hardware-and-software-requirements)** ## Docker Strapi 不提供官方 Docker 镜像，因此需要基于自己的项目构建。可以通过社区 CLI 工具快速开始： ```bash npx @strapi-community/dockerize@latest ``` 该工具会生成适合项目的 `Dockerfile` 和 `docker-compose.yml`。更多详情请参阅 [strapi-tool-dockerize](https://github.com/strapi-community/strapi-tool-dockerize) 仓库。 > Dockerfile、Docker Compose 示例和生产构建请参阅 **[Docker 安装文档](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/installation/docker)** ## 部署到 Strapi Cloud 从本地进入生产环境的一种快速方式。Strapi Cloud 是官方托管平台，提供零 DevOps、内置数据库、媒体库和 CDN。 > [**立即部署**](https://cloud.strapi.io) ## LaunchPad 结合 Strapi 和 Next.js 的官方演示模板，帮助你快速上手。 > [**LaunchPad template**](https://github.com/strapi/LaunchPad) ### 试用在线演示 访问带有示例数据的[托管 Strapi 项目](https://strapi.io/demo)，了解其内部工作方式——[在线试用](https://strapi.io/demo)或[拉取到本地](https://github.com/strapi/LaunchPad)。 ## 仓库 | 仓库 | 说明 | | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | | [**strapi/strapi**](https://github.com/strapi/strapi) | 核心单体仓库，即 CMS 本身 | | [**strapi/design-system**](https://github.com/strapi/design-system) | Strapi 设计系统，React 组件库 | | [**strapi/LaunchPad**](https://github.com/strapi/LaunchPad) | 演示应用：Strapi + Next.js | ## 贡献与社区 Strapi 由社区共同构建并开源。如需帮助、提供反馈或参与： - **[Discord](https://discord.strapi.io)**：与社区和 Strapi 团队实时讨论 - **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/discussions)**：提问、分享项目并获取反馈 - **[GitHub](https://github.com/strapi/strapi)**：报告错误和参与贡献 - **[贡献指南](https://contributor.strapi.io/)**：如何贡献代码、文档和翻译 - **[社区内容](https://github.com/strapi/community-content)**：展示、教程、入门项目和模板 - **[反馈](https://feedback.strapi.io)**：路线图和功能请求 - **[Twitter](https://twitter.com/strapijs)**：快速获取消息 - **[YouTube 频道](https://www.youtube.com/strapi)**：通过视频教程学习 一般帮助请参阅 [Strapi 官方文档](https://docs.strapi.io)。初次接触开源？请查看[如何参与开源贡献](https://opensource.guide/)。 ## 迁移 按照文档中的[迁移指南](https://docs.strapi.io/developer-docs/latest/update-migration-guides/migration-guides.html)保持项目更新。 ## 路线图 查看[路线图](https://feedback.strapi.io)，了解已发布和即将推出的功能。你也可以提供意见并为特定功能投票。 ## 文档 Strapi 文档请参阅专用[仓库](https://github.com/strapi/documentation)，或在线查看： - [CMS 文档](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/intro) - [云端文档](https://docs.strapi.io/cloud/intro) ## 安全 如果发现安全问题，请负责任地报告。有关披露流程和联系信息，请参阅[安全政策](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/blob/main/SECURITY.md)。 ## 关于 Strapi - **[公司手册](https://handbook.strapi.io)**：我们的价值观、工作方式等 - **[关于我们](https://strapi.io/about-us)**：Strapi 的故事 [联系我们](https://strapi.io/contact) ## 支持 Strapi 如果 Strapi 对你有用，欢迎点星支持。这比你想象的更有帮助！ ## 感谢所有贡献者 感谢所有贡献代码、报告问题并帮助塑造 Strapi 的人。 [![Strapi contributors](https://contrib.rocks/image?repo=strapi/strapi&max=400&columns=20)](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/graphs/contributors) ## 许可证 许可信息请参阅 [LICENSE](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/blob/73032435344ce40b4d756745dd5cbbbe24039911/LICENSE) 文件。 --- [官网](https://strapi.io) · [文档](https://docs.strapi.io) · [博客](https://strapi.io/blog) · [Twitter](https://twitter.com/strapijs) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/strapi/)
en:
Open-source headless CMS, self-hosted or Cloud you're in control.

The leading open-source headless CMS, 100% JavaScript/TypeScript, flexible and fully customizable.

Docs · Strapi Cloud · Roadmap · Discord · Discussions


Strapi is an open-source, self-hosted headless CMS that lets developers build content APIs fast while giving content creators a friendly editing interface. Define your content models and Strapi generates a full API, ready to consume from any frontend, mobile app, or IoT device. - Design content structures visually with the [**Content-Type Builder**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/content-type-builder), no code required - Auto-generated [**REST**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/api/rest) & [**GraphQL**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/plugins/graphql) APIs for every content type - Granular [**Roles & Permissions**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/users-permissions) out of the box - Built-in [**Media Library**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/media-library), [**Internationalization (i18n)**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/internationalization), and [**Draft & Publish**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/features/draft-and-publish) - First-class **TypeScript** support with flexible database options (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB) - Extensible [**plugin system**](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/plugins-development/developing-plugins) and customizable admin dashboard > Explore all features at **[strapi.io/features](https://strapi.io/features)** > **Strapi AI** — Automate content modeling, media alt text, and translations with Strapi's built-in AI layer. [Learn more](https://strapi.io/ai) ### How Strapi handles requests Every incoming request flows through a layered backend architecture: **Routes → Middlewares → Controllers → Services**.

> Learn more about backend customization in the [official docs](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/backend-customization). ## Getting Started Read the Getting Started tutorial or follow the steps below: ### ⏳ Installation Use the **Quickstart** command below to create a new Strapi project instantly: ```bash npx create-strapi@latest my-project ``` This command generates a brand new project with the default features (authentication, permissions, content management, content type builder & file upload). > Full installation options (including TypeScript, `--quickstart`, etc.) in the **[CLI installation docs](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/installation/cli#creating-a-strapi-project)** ### Requirements > Hardware & software requirements (OS, Node.js, databases) at **[Requirements docs](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/deployment#hardware-and-software-requirements)** ## Docker Strapi doesn't ship official Docker images, so you build your own from your project. The fastest way to get started is with the community CLI tool: ```bash npx @strapi-community/dockerize@latest ``` This generates a `Dockerfile` and `docker-compose.yml` tailored to your project. See the [strapi-tool-dockerize](https://github.com/strapi-community/strapi-tool-dockerize) repo for more details. > Dockerfiles, Docker Compose examples, production builds at **[Docker installation docs](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/installation/docker)** ## Deploy to Strapi Cloud The fastest way to go from local to production. Strapi Cloud is the official managed hosting platform with zero DevOps, a built-in database, media library, and CDN. > [**Deploy now**](https://cloud.strapi.io) ## LaunchPad The official demo template combining Strapi with Next.js to get you started quickly. > [**LaunchPad template**](https://github.com/strapi/LaunchPad) ### Try live demo See for yourself what's under the hood by getting access to a [hosted Strapi project](https://strapi.io/demo) with sample data — [try it live](https://strapi.io/demo) or [pull locally](https://github.com/strapi/LaunchPad). ## Repositories | Repository | Description | | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | | [**strapi/strapi**](https://github.com/strapi/strapi) | Core monorepo, the CMS itself | | [**strapi/design-system**](https://github.com/strapi/design-system) | Strapi Design System, React component library | | [**strapi/LaunchPad**](https://github.com/strapi/LaunchPad) | Demo app: Strapi + Next.js | ## Contributing & Community Strapi is community-built and open source. For help, feedback, or to get involved: - **[Discord](https://discord.strapi.io)**: Live discussion with the community and Strapi team - **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/discussions)**: Ask questions, share projects, get feedback - **[GitHub](https://github.com/strapi/strapi)**: Bug reports and contributions - **[Contributing Guide](https://contributor.strapi.io/)**: How to contribute code, docs, and translations - **[Community Content](https://github.com/strapi/community-content)**: Showcase, tutorials, starters, and templates - **[Feedback](https://feedback.strapi.io)**: Roadmap and feature requests - **[Twitter](https://twitter.com/strapijs)**: Get the news fast - **[YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/strapi)**: Learn from video tutorials For general help, refer to the [official Strapi documentation](https://docs.strapi.io). New to open source? Check out [How to Contribute to Open Source](https://opensource.guide/). ## Migration Follow our [migration guides](https://docs.strapi.io/developer-docs/latest/update-migration-guides/migration-guides.html) on the documentation to keep your projects up-to-date. ## Roadmap Check out our [roadmap](https://feedback.strapi.io) to get informed of the latest features released and the upcoming ones. You may also give us insights and vote for a specific feature. ## Documentation See our dedicated [repository](https://github.com/strapi/documentation) for the Strapi documentation, or view our documentation live: - [CMS docs](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/intro) - [Cloud docs](https://docs.strapi.io/cloud/intro) ## Security If you discover a security issue, please report it responsibly. See our [Security Policy](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for our disclosure process and contact info. ## About Strapi - **[Company Handbook](https://handbook.strapi.io)**: Our values, how we work, and more - **[About Us](https://strapi.io/about-us)**: The story of Strapi [Contact us](https://strapi.io/contact) ## Support Strapi If Strapi is useful to you, give us a star. It helps more than you think! ## Thanks to All Contributors Thank you to everyone who has contributed code, reported issues, and helped shape Strapi. [![Strapi contributors](https://contrib.rocks/image?repo=strapi/strapi&max=400&columns=20)](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/graphs/contributors) ## License See the [LICENSE](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/blob/73032435344ce40b4d756745dd5cbbbe24039911/LICENSE) file for licensing information. --- [Website](https://strapi.io) · [Docs](https://docs.strapi.io) · [Blog](https://strapi.io/blog) · [Twitter](https://twitter.com/strapijs) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/strapi/)
